title: Start a self-paced review game
description: Live tour: launch a self-paced Review game and run it from the game board.

steps.label: Start button
steps.text: Click **Start** on the quiz you want to play, then click Next.

steps.label: Teacher-paced
steps.text: **Teacher-paced** shows one question at a time on the board. Everyone answers before you move on.

steps.label: Self-paced game
steps.text: Click **Self-paced game**. Students work through the questions on their own devices until time runs out.

steps.label: Game length
steps.text: Pick how long the game runs.

steps.label: Leaderboard size
steps.text: Choose how many ranks the board shows: Top 5, Top 10 or Everyone.

steps.label: Start
steps.text: Pick your classes, then click **Start**. Students join with the code, as they do for a quiz.

steps.label: Game board
steps.text: The board shows time left, how many students are playing, **first-try** accuracy and the leaderboard.

steps.label: Start game
steps.text: When students have joined, click **Start game** to start the clock.

steps.label: Pause
steps.text: **Pause** stops the clock on every device until you resume.

steps.label: Add a minute
steps.text: Add a minute whenever the class needs more time.

steps.label: Names
steps.text: Names stay hidden on the board until you turn them on.

steps.label: End game
steps.text: **End game** stops the game for everyone. Results move to the Review archive.

welcomeMessage: Start a self-paced review game from a quiz in your library.
